subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Each book carried not only the author's words, but also classmates' voices.”?
options: Reading became less lonely when students could leave thoughts for the next reader.
Clean energy became less abstract when students could watch it being made above their own classrooms.
The contest became less about stars and more about helping tomorrow's self.
The lunch bell returned the next day, but a few students started wearing watches.
